overview: 本期共收录 9 篇论文。研究方向主要集中在金融经济学（4 篇）、风险管理与衍生品（2 篇）、行为金融（1 篇）。方法上以调查数据、实验方法为主。来源分布：Semantic Scholar（5 篇）、arXiv（4 篇）。

papers.title: AI Sycophancy and Decisions
papers.abstract: We examine whether sycophantic AI advice distorts decisions. Our experiment involves 1,500 participants in 30 decision environments spanning core domains in economics and the social sciences. Contrary to the vast majority of predictions in an expert survey we conduct, we find that AI advice depolarizes choices on average, moving participants away from their initial leanings. This depolarization arises despite the LLM being measurably sycophantic: it disproportionately offers considerations that support users' initial leanings and uses agreeable and flattering language. Depolarization occurs across moral and non-moral, objective and subjective, strategic and non-strategic, and complex and simple tasks. Increasing sycophancy weakens depolarization, showing that sycophancy is behaviorally relevant, even if it is generally outweighed by the informativeness of AI advice. Finally, several results mitigate the concern that market forces will generate greater polarizing effects outside the experiment or in the future. On the supply side, our baseline AI's level of sycophancy is typical of leading models, and these models are not becoming more sycophantic over time. On the demand side, participants do not prefer greater sycophancy, do not select into AI advice in tasks where it is more polarizing, and exhibit greater depolarizing effects when they are more frequent AI users outside the experiment.
papers.summary_zh: 【金融经济学】我们研究了阿谀奉承式的人工智能建议是否会导致决策偏差。实验共有1500名参与者参与，他们在涵盖经济学和社会科学核心领域的30个决策情境中进行了测试。与专家调查中的绝大多数预测结果相反，我们发现人工智能建议总体上起到了缓和观点分歧的作用，使参与者的初始倾向趋于缓和。尽管大型语言模型（LLM）表现出明显的阿谀奉承行为——它更倾向于提供支持用户初始观点的内容，并使用讨好和奉承性的语言，但这种效果仍然出现了。这种观点的缓和现象既出现在道德与非道德、客观与主观、战略性与非战略性以及复杂与简单任务中。研究发现，人工智能的阿谀奉承程度越高，其缓和分歧的效果反而越弱，这表明阿谀奉承行为确实具有实际影响，尽管其影响通常会被人工智能建议的信息价值所抵消。最后，一些研究结果缓解了人们对市场力量可能在实验之外或未来产生更大分歧效应的担忧：从供给方面来看，我们使用的基线人工智能模型的阿谀奉承程度属于行业平均水平，且这些模型并未随着时间推移而变得更加谄媚；从需求方面来看，参与者并不更偏好更具阿谀奉承特性的建议，在那些建议可能引发更大分歧的任务中，他们也不会主动选择这类建议；此外，在实验之外，作为更频繁使用人...。研究方法：实验方法、调查数据。

papers.title: Nonfundamentalness or missing information ? Evidence from causal-noncausal VARs in macro-finance
papers.abstract: This paper studies the presence of noncausal dynamics in standard macro-finance VAR models and asks whether they reflect genuine nonfundamentalness or omitted information available to economic agents but unobserved by the econometrician. To that end, we introduce a factor-filtering mixed causal-noncausal VARX approach designed to account for common macroeconomic information. We assess its performance in simulated settings, while showing also that the generalized covariance (GCov) estimator correctly recovers causal and noncausal dynamics when using several lags. Empirically, we revisit the well-known Stock-Watson monetary policy (S)VAR and show that the noncausal components detected in the baseline specification largely disappear once common factors are filtered out. Finally, we compare impulse responses from the filtered and original data to assess the transmission of monetary policy shocks and show that filtering further removes the price puzzle.
papers.summary_zh: 【风险管理与衍生品】本文研究了标准宏观金融向量自回归（VAR）模型中存在的非因果动态现象，并探讨这些现象是反映了经济主体的某些非基本面特征，还是由于计量经济学家未能观察到某些可供经济主体使用的信息所致。为此，我们提出了一种结合因子过滤技术的混合因果-非因果VARX模型，旨在考虑各种常见的宏观经济因素。我们在模拟环境中对该模型的性能进行了评估，并发现广义协方差（GCov）估计量在采用多个滞后项时能够准确识别出因果与非因果动态关系。实证分析方面，我们重新审视了著名的Stock-Watson货币政策VAR模型，发现当过滤掉共同因素后，基线模型中检测到的非因果成分基本消失。最后，我们比较了过滤处理前后数据的脉冲响应，以评估货币政策的传导效应，结果表明进一步过滤处理能够有效解决“价格之谜”（即货币政策冲击对价格变化的解释难题）。。研究方法：向量自回归。

papers.title: Employer perceptions of older workers – surveys from 2019 and 2006
papers.venue: Journal of Pension Economics and Finance
papers.abstract: This paper reports on a 2019 survey of employer perceptions of the productivity, costs, and net value of older workers relative to younger ones, replicating a similar 2006 effort. The key result of the 2019 survey is that older workers have good prospects for extending their careers. Although older workers are seen as costlier, they are also seen as more productive. Overall, the overwhelming majority of employers said older workers were ‘as attractive’ or ‘more attractive’ than younger workers. The main finding from a comparison of the 2019 and 2006 results is an improvement in employer perceptions of support workers.
papers.summary_zh: 【金融经济学】本文报告了2019年的一项调查结果，该调查探讨了雇主对老年员工与年轻员工在生产力、成本及净价值方面的看法，这一研究复制了2006年进行的类似调查。2019年调查的主要发现是：老年员工有较大的机会延长职业生涯。尽管老年员工被认为成本较高，但他们也被认为更具生产力。总体而言，绝大多数雇主表示老年员工与年轻员工“同样具有吸引力”或“更具吸引力”。对比2019年和2006年的调查结果，主要发现是雇主对辅助性员工（如后勤支持人员等）的看法有所改善。。研究方法：调查数据。

papers.title: Nearshoring readiness: a readiness dashboard to navigate global value chain relocation
papers.venue: Journal of Economics Finance and Administrative Science
papers.abstract:
This research proposes a readiness dashboard (RD) to evaluate national competitiveness in the shifting landscape of global value chains. It analyzes the transition from cost-centric offshoring to security-focused nearshoring and friendshoring, driven by post-pandemic geopolitical tensions.
 
 
 
 The RD is a multidimensional framework that operationalizes national competitiveness with 32 variables structured across four pillars: institutions, infrastructure, integration and inputs, providing comparable metrics for 124 countries.
 
 
 
 This study concludes that while infrastructure is necessary, institutional quality and deep trade integration are the primary factors in capturing trade diverted from the USA market. The inputs dimension remains the biggest challenge, while integration is a relative strength for lower-income countries. Focusing on the Americas, a region of one billion people with a gross domestic product of USD 34 trillion, the study highlights how strategic policy alignment can help Latin American countries capture a significant share of trade relocated from the US.
 
 
 
 The research provides a strategic tool for policymakers to identify structural voids and design targeted policies that mitigate geopolitical risks while fostering long-term investment to orient business-people's investment destinations.
papers.summary_zh:
【金融经济学】本研究提出了一种“竞争力监测仪表盘”（Readiness Dashboard，简称RD），用于评估各国在全球价值链不断变化的环境中的竞争力。该仪表盘分析了从以成本为中心的离岸外包向以安全为导向的近岸外包及友岸外包的转变过程，这一转变受到疫情后地缘政治紧张局势的推动。

RD是一个多维度的框架，通过32个变量来衡量国家竞争力，这些变量涵盖了四个核心方面：制度、基础设施、一体化程度以及投入要素，从而为124个国家提供了可比较的竞争力指标。

研究结果表明，虽然基础设施至关重要，但制度质量与深度贸易一体化才是吸引从美国市场转移过来的贸易流量的关键因素。在投入要素方面，各国仍面临较大挑战；而对于低收入国家而言，贸易一体化则是一个相对优势。以拥有10亿人口、国内生产总值达34万亿美元的美洲地区为例，研究强调了战略性政策协调的重要性——这种协调有助于拉丁美洲国家抓住从美国转移过来的贸易机会。

该研究为政策制定者提供了有力工具，帮助他们识别潜在的结构性缺陷，并设计针对性的政策，以降低地缘政治风险，同时促进长期投资，引导企业和个人选择合适的投资目的地。。

papers.title: FinSMART: Financial Sentiment Analysis for Algorithmic Trading through Market-Aligned Reinforcement Learning
papers.abstract: Recent advances in Generative AI have substantially improved financial sentiment analysis through post-trained financial large language models (LLMs). However, existing approaches remain confined to a market-agnostic, supervised learning paradigm that relies on limited, static and human-annotated datasets, and thus are incapable of adapting to evolving market conditions. To address this limitation, we introduce FinSMART, the first market-aligned reinforcement learning framework for financial sentiment analysis, which directly optimizes sentiment signals using realized market outcomes. To deal with the noisy, non-stationary, and multifactorial nature of financial markets, FinSMART incorporates a signal extraction pipeline that combines market-aware data filtering with a discrete asymmetric trading reward, enabling stable reinforcement learning from economically meaningful market feedback. Experimental results demonstrate that FinSMART significantly outperforms existing state-of-the-art methods in profitability, risk-adjusted performance, and sentiment signal quality, improving cumulative trading returns by 220% over the strongest baseline. Uniquely, the FinSMART framework naturally supports market-aware retraining, at any point in time, by replacing costly manual annotation with newly observed financial articles and their realized market outcomes. Such a retraining strategy enables the model to continuously adapt to changing market dynamics, resulting in consistent performance gains over its static counterpart. These findings demonstrate the practical applicability of market-aligned reinforcement learning and highlight its potential as a next-generation paradigm for developing adaptive financial LLMs.
papers.summary_zh: 【行为金融】近期，生成式人工智能（Generative AI）的进步显著提升了通过预训练的金融大型语言模型（financial LLMs）进行金融情感分析的能力。然而，现有方法仍局限于一种与市场无关的监督学习范式，这些方法依赖于有限、静态且由人工标注的数据集，因此无法适应不断变化的市场环境。为了解决这一局限性，我们提出了FinSMART——首个基于市场反馈的金融情感分析强化学习框架，该框架直接利用实际市场结果来优化情感信号。为应对金融市场的噪声性、非平稳性和多因素特性，FinSMART结合了市场感知的数据过滤机制与离散的非对称交易奖励机制，从而能够从具有经济意义的市场反馈中实现稳定的强化学习过程。实验结果表明，FinSMART在盈利能力、风险调整后的表现以及情感信号质量方面均显著优于现有的最先进方法，其累计交易回报比最强基线模型提高了220%。独特之处在于，FinSMART框架支持在任何时间点进行市场感知的重新训练，仅需用新观察到的金融文章及其实际市场结果替代繁琐的人工标注过程。这种重新训练策略使模型能够持续适应市场动态的变化，从而在性能上优于其静态对应模型。这些发现证明了基于市场反馈的强化...。研究方法：大语言模型、情绪分析、实验方法。

papers.title: Scaling, Lock-In, and Proxy Compliance: A Political Economy of Responsible AI
papers.abstract: AI accountability at scale is an institutional problem: who can observe, verify, and change deployed systems. We develop a sequential political-economy model in which an AI vendor chooses auditability and substantive mitigation, a deployer monitors after adoption while facing switching costs, and enforcement depends on verifiable evidence. Anticipating the deployer's monitoring response, the vendor may stop at an observable procurement floor while mitigating below the social first best, producing a proxy-compliance equilibrium. We characterize the unique interior equilibrium and the corner in which harm is fully mitigated. Independent audit rights raise enforcement exposure directly; portability restores deployer leverage; incident reporting adds a regulator-visible evidence channel; and outcome-linked liability creates incentives that do not depend on vendor-controlled detection. The results explain why documentation and standardized evaluations can coexist with persistent post-deployment harms, and generate testable implications for monitoring, mitigation, and the gap between formal compliance and operational outcomes.
papers.summary_zh: 【金融经济学】大规模应用中的AI责任问题本质上是一个制度性问题：谁能够监督、验证并改进已部署的系统？我们构建了一个序贯的政治经济模型，在该模型中，AI供应商会选择是否具备可审计性以及采取何种实质性缓解措施；系统部署者在采用后负责后续监控，同时需要承担转换成本；而监管的执行则依赖于可验证的证据。考虑到部署者的监控行为，供应商可能会在采取的缓解措施低于社会最优水平的情况下，选择停留在一个可观察到的最低采购标准上，从而形成一种“代理合规”状态。我们分析了这种独特的内部均衡机制，以及能够完全消除危害的临界条件。独立的审计权会直接增加监管的介入力度；系统的可移植性有助于提升部署者的谈判地位；事件报告机制为监管机构提供了可见的证据渠道；而与结果挂钩的责任机制则产生了不依赖于供应商检测能力的激励机制。研究结果解释了为何在系统部署后仍存在持续危害的情况下，文档记录和标准化评估仍能共存，并为监控机制、缓解措施以及正式合规性与实际运行效果之间的差距提供了可验证的见解。。研究方法：均衡模型。

papers.title: Islamic Financial Technology (FinTech) Development in Saudi Arabia and Egypt: A Comparative Institutional and Sharia-Compliance Analysis
papers.venue: International Journal of Islamic Economics and Finance Research
papers.abstract:
Purpose – This study addresses the limited cross-country evidence on how institutional arrangements, regulatory architecture, Sharia governance, and digital readiness shape Islamic FinTech development in Saudi Arabia and Egypt. It compares the two ecosystems and identifies the institutional conditions associated with coordinated innovation, market inclusion, and Sharia-aligned outcomes.
Design/Methodologies/Approach – The study uses a comparative secondary-data institutional design that integrates descriptive indicators with qualitative document analysis. A structured identification, screening, selection, and extraction procedure was applied to 35 sources: 15 academic or theoretical publications and 20 regulatory, institutional, or industry documents. Evidence was entered into a standardised extraction matrix, coded across four analytical dimensions, and triangulated across independent sources where possible.
Findings – Saudi Arabia exhibits a more centralised, regulation-led and infrastructure-driven pathway, while Egypt exhibits a more inclusion-oriented and entrepreneurship-led pathway. The comparison indicates selective convergence in regulatory capability, digital infrastructure, and governance standards, while important differences remain in institutional coordination, market structure, and the organisation of Sharia oversight.
Originality/Value – The study integrates institutional theory, innovation-diffusion theory, and Islamic economic principles, particularly Maqasid al-Sharia, within a single comparative framework. It also distinguishes direct Islamic FinTech evidence from broader FinTech and digital-finance indicators used only as contextual proxies.
Research Limitations/Implication – The analysis is limited to two countries and relies on publicly available secondary sources. Islamic-specific market data are not consistently disaggregated, some indicators use different reference years, and coding was conducted by one researcher. The findings should therefore be interpreted as comparative institutional evidence rather than causal estimates.
Practical Implications – The findings support clearer Sharia-governance responsibilities, stronger documentation and disclosure, coordinated regulatory sandboxes, investment in digital and cybersecurity infrastructure, and regional cooperation on interoperable standards. They also provide a practical basis for regulators and market participants to distinguish ecosystem growth from verified Sharia-compliant market activity.
papers.summary_zh:
【金融科技】**目的**：本研究旨在探讨制度安排、监管架构、伊斯兰教法治理以及数字化准备程度对沙特阿拉伯和埃及伊斯兰金融科技发展的影响，这些方面的跨国证据较为有限。通过对比这两个国家的金融生态系统，本研究识别出与协同创新、市场包容性以及符合伊斯兰教法要求的成果相关的制度条件。

**设计/方法/途径**：本研究采用比较性二手数据方法，结合描述性指标与定性文献分析。研究对35个来源进行了系统的识别、筛选、选择和数据提取工作，其中包括15篇学术或理论文献以及20份监管、制度或行业文件。所有数据被录入标准化提取矩阵，并根据四个分析维度进行编码；在可能的情况下，通过多个独立来源对数据进行了交叉验证。

**研究结果**：沙特阿拉伯的金融发展路径更倾向于中央集权、以监管为主导且以基础设施为支撑；而埃及的金融发展路径则更注重市场包容性和创业精神。比较结果显示，在监管能力、数字基础设施和治理标准方面存在一定程度的趋同，但在制度协调性、市场结构以及伊斯兰教法监督的组织方式上仍存在显著差异。

**创新性/价值**：本研究将制度理论、创新扩散理论以及伊斯兰经济原则（特别是伊斯兰教法的宗旨）整合到一个统一的比较...。

papers.title: Determinants of Maqasid Shariah Performance in Islamic Banks: Evidence from Southeast Asia
papers.venue: International Journal of Islamic Economics and Finance Research
papers.abstract:
Purpose – This study aims to analyse the effect of Islamic Social Reporting (ISR), Islamic Corporate Governance (ICG), Intellectual Capital (IC), and risk-taking—proxied by Non-Performing Financing (NPF) and Z-Score—on the Maqasid Shariah Index in Islamic Commercial Banks.
Design/Methodology/Approach – The study employs a quantitative research design using secondary data obtained from the financial statements of Islamic Commercial Banks in Indonesia for the 2018–2023 period. A purposive sampling technique was applied, resulting in a sample of 15 banks. Data were analysed using panel data analysis to examine the relationships between ISR, ICG, IC, risk-taking variables, and the Maqasid Shariah Index.
Findings – The results show that Islamic Corporate Governance has a positive and significant effect on the Maqasid Shariah Index. Meanwhile, risk-taking measured by Z-Score has a negative impact on the Maqasid Shariah Index. Islamic Social Reporting, Intellectual Capital, and risk-taking measured by Non-Performing Financing do not demonstrate significant relationships.
Originality/Value – This study contributes to the literature by integrating governance, social disclosure, intellectual capital, and risk-taking dimensions within the framework of Maqasid Shariah performance measurement in Islamic banking.
Research Limitations/Implications – The study is limited to Islamic Commercial Banks and covers the 2018–2023 period, which may restrict the generalisability of findings to other Islamic financial institutions or broader time horizons. Future research may expand the sample scope and incorporate additional explanatory variables.
Practical Implications – The findings provide insights for Islamic bank management, regulators, and policymakers in strengthening governance practices to improve Maqasid Shariah performance while maintaining prudent risk management.
papers.summary_zh:
【银行与信贷】**目的**：本研究旨在分析伊斯兰社会报告（ISR）、伊斯兰企业治理（ICG）、智力资本（IC）以及风险承担（通过不良贷款率（NPF）和Z分数来衡量）对伊斯兰商业银行的伊斯兰教法目标指数（Maqasid Shariah Index）的影响。

**设计/方法/途径**：本研究采用定量研究方法，利用2018年至2023年间印度尼西亚伊斯兰商业银行的财务报表中的二手数据。采用目的性抽样技术，最终选取了15家银行作为样本。通过面板数据分析方法，研究ISR、ICG、智力资本、风险承担变量与伊斯兰教法目标指数之间的关系。

**研究结果**：研究表明，伊斯兰企业治理对伊斯兰教法目标指数具有积极且显著的影响；而通过Z分数衡量的风险承担则对该指数产生负面影响。伊斯兰社会报告、智力资本以及通过不良贷款率衡量的风险承担并未显示出显著的相关性。

**创新性/价值**：本研究将治理、社会披露、智力资本和风险承担这三个维度纳入伊斯兰银行业绩效评估的框架中，为相关文献做出了贡献。

**研究局限性与启示**：本研究仅针对伊斯兰商业银行，并局限于2018至2023年的时间段，这可能限制了研究结果在其他伊斯...。研究方法：面板数据。

papers.title: The Impact of Financial Literacy on Investment Decisions: The Mediating Roles of Investment Strategy and Risk Management
papers.venue: Journal of Economics, Finance and Accounting Studies
papers.abstract: This research paper will examine the effect of financial literacy on Investment decision. Financial literacy is one of the most influential factors in determining the investment decision and developing investment strategy and managing financial risk for the investors. A quantitative cross-sectional study was carried out among individual investors and future investors in Dhaka, Bangladesh. Survey data were collected by structured self-administrated questionnaire in offline and online surveys. For analysis of the proposed conceptual model, Partial Least Squares Structural Equation Modeling (PLS-SEM) was applied using SmartPLS 4 software. Reliability, convergent validity, discriminant validity, structural relationships, and mediating effect were tested in accordance with the standard PLS-SEM methods. Financial literacy had a highly significant direct influence on investment decision (β = 0.512, p < 0.001). Financial literacy had a highly significant effect on investment strategy (β = 0.714, p < 0.001) and risk management (β = 0.655, p < 0.001). Investment strategy (β = 0.253, p = 0.012) and risk management (β = 0.574, p < 0.001) positively influenced the investment decision. Mediating effect analysis has found highly significant indirect influence through investment strategy (β = 0.181, p = 0.013) and risk management (β = 0.376, p < 0.001). The aspect of financial literacy plays a vital role in improving investment decisions both directly and indirectly. Better financial education and risk management techniques can help individual investors in making better decisions on investing and adopting sustainable investment behavior.
papers.summary_zh: 【风险管理与衍生品】本研究论文将探讨金融素养对投资决策的影响。金融素养是决定投资决策、制定投资策略以及管理投资者财务风险的最重要因素之一。研究在孟加拉国达卡的现有投资者和潜在投资者中开展了一项定量横断面调查，数据通过结构化自填问卷在线下和线上方式收集。为了分析所提出的概念模型，采用了SmartPLS 4软件进行偏最小二乘结构方程模型（PLS-SEM）分析。研究按照标准的PLS-SEM方法检验了数据的可靠性、收敛效度、区分效度、结构关系以及中介效应。结果表明，金融素养对投资决策具有显著的正向直接影响（β = 0.512，p < 0.001）；同时对投资策略（β = 0.714，p < 0.001）和风险管理（β = 0.655，p < 0.001）也具有显著影响。此外，投资策略（β = 0.253，p = 0.012）和风险管理（β = 0.574，p < 0.001）也对投资决策产生积极影响。中介效应分析显示，金融素养通过投资策略（β = 0.181，p = 0.013）和风险管理（β = 0.376，p < 0.001）对投资决策具有显著的间接促进作用。金融素养在直接和间接两个方面都对改善投资决策...。研究方法：横截面分析、调查数据。
